highlights: GPA 4.0/4.0; Singapore Computer Society Silver Medal.

Fixed a production video moderation agent that often flagged entire videos instead of the violating segment, raising precise timestamp output from 72% to 91% by enforcing structured JSON output and fixing a validation bug.

Built a 3,900-case benchmark to test whether retrieving past moderation decisions (RAG) improves an LLM moderation agent, and prototyped an autoresearch agent that lets ops teams run their own experiments.
Added token, latency, and cache metrics and a Grafana dashboard to a Go captioning service to track LLM cost.
Built a voice-agent evaluation framework to compare agent quality across simulated conversations using automated scoring and Langfuse trace analysis.
Developed form analytics, document-to-form generation, and real-time voice-agent pipelines with TypeScript, FastAPI, and Pipecat.
Built an LLM-powered exam-marking platform with custom RAG over exam materials that reduced instructor grading time by over 50% in an air-gapped environment.
Improved grader accuracy and robustness by benchmarking prompts and automating prompt optimization with DSPy and open-source data.
Integrated Langfuse telemetry to monitor traces, latency, and scoring quality, reducing time spent debugging the pipeline.
Built a neural search API for unstructured enterprise documents with Elasticsearch, ONNX Runtime, Jina, FastAPI, and MongoDB, supporting public-sector and enterprise pilots.
Improved document-layout detection throughput by 400% by distilling and quantizing an RTMDet model for production inference.
Deployed pilot systems on GCP and refactored services for self-hosted environments to enable on-premise adoption with SkillsFuture SG, NSCC, and Coherent, Inc.
Built an internal MLOps model hub with Vue.js, FastAPI, and MongoDB that let teams deploy ML models as Kubernetes services.
Automated deployment to air-gapped Kubernetes environments with Skaffold, Helm, and service-scaling APIs for 2 departments.
Established a GitHub Actions CI pipeline for unit testing and linting to improve code quality and release confidence.

Awards & Open Source.bullet: 1st Place (University Category), HPC Innovation Competition 2023, for OwlShield, an LLM safety firewall.
Contributed a [LiteLLM integration](https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/572) to NVIDIA's Garak, an open-source LLM security scanner (8k+ stars).
